g.title: Sheet.133
g.desc: What if the server uses 10.1.1.2 as a default gateway and R1 ...
g.text: Every node on the local network receives the HSRP hello packets. Only nodes listening to the 224.0.0.2 multicast group process the HSRP packets.Hence, PC1 discards them.
